svg.title: Tiling an 8 by 20 times 20 by 8 product on a 4 by 4 array
svg.desc: The output C is four 4 by 4 tiles. Each output tile uses the matching four A rows and four B columns. For each tile, run once with k 0 through 15 and accumulate low, then run with k 16 through 19, k_len 4, and accumulate high. The first run clears the partial sum; the second adds to it.
